name: smwgraphics-super-mario-world-2-yoshi-s-island-layer
title: Super Mario World 2: Yoshi's Island - Layer 3 Water
description:
The layer 3 water used in Yoshi's Island, mainly seen in the level 4-6. Uses 4 animation slots.

Keep in mind that, due to SMW physics, the water will move you, unlike in Yoshi's Island, where it doesn't. For this, there is an hex edit included to make the layer 3 tides don't move Mario (keep in mind this is a global change). Alternatively you can make this water to have auto-scroll like in SMW, but due to the style of the animation it doesn't fit too well.
